name: ledgerbridge
description: Integration hub syncing billing and procurement apps into an ERP

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w mock-erp -w integration-service
scripts.build:lambda: npm run build:shared && npm run build:lambda -w mock-erp -w integration-service
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:shared && npm run test:e2e --workspaces --if-present
scripts.synth: npm run build:lambda && npm run cdk -w infra -- synth --profile ledgerbridge
scripts.deploy: npm run build:lambda && npm run cdk -w infra -- deploy --all --outputs-file cdk-outputs.json --profile ledgerbridge
scripts.destroy: npm run cdk -w infra -- destroy --all --profile ledgerbridge
